name: Grant status card
purpose: Show a donor's grant status (headline, amount, charity) inside a partner site, read-only.
authentication: Short-lived, sponsor-scoped, audience-bound token issued server-to-server by the sponsor's Unbound origin to the registered host after the person's consent (authorization-code flow with PKCE in a sponsor-origin window; the host never sees credentials); bound to widget type, host origin and principal; expiry and revocation clear all data in the frame and show 'Sign in again on your provider's site' (UNB-UI-W-001 AC-1)
authorization: Grant must belong to a fund the principal can view; host learns nothing beyond what the card displays
sponsor_branding: Sponsor Brand Kit applied inside the frame from the sponsor's published brand manifest (data-forma-brand); host cannot restyle beyond documented CSS custom properties passed as theme tokens (light/dark, density) validated for 4.5:1 text contrast; legal-sponsor disclosure sentence and sponsor name always visible inside the frame (UNB-UI-G-014); the widget never presents itself as the host's product.
host_integration: Rendered inside an iframe served from the sponsor's Unbound origin (never inline in the host DOM); optional loader custom element <unbound-widget type=... version=...> only creates and sizes the iframe and relays allowed events. Unbound response headers: CSP frame-ancestors = the exact registered host origins (no wildcards); frame sets X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy strict-origin, Permissions-Policy denying camera/microphone/geolocation/payment. Host embeds with sandbox='allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-popups' and must allow the sponsor origin in its own CSP frame-src. postMessage is accepted only from/to the registered host origin and carries only the event types listed in event_contracts (UNB-GAP-W-01). No third-party scripts or tracking inside the frame.
data_boundaries: Shows: grant reference, headline status, amount, charity name, last update time. Never: fund balance, other grants, donor PII beyond first name, compliance reasons for holds ('On hold' with 'Contact your sponsor').
accessibility: Frame has a host-supplied title (required attribute; loader refuses to render without it)
Content inside the frame passes axe-core wcag2a..wcag22aa with 0 violations at 320 and 600 px frame widths
Keyboard focus enters and leaves the frame in document order; no focus trap except in its own confirmation dialog
Height reported to host so no inner scrollbars hide content; text reflows at 320 px; supports 200% zoom
Status chips use text, never colour alone; live updates announced politely once
error_handling: Token expired or revoked: clear data, show 'Sign in again on your provider's site', emit widget.auth_required
Service unavailable: 'Information is unavailable right now' with sponsor contact; emit widget.error {code, reference}; no stale data shown as current
Stale data beyond freshness limit: value labelled 'Not current' with as-of (UNB-UI-G-003)
Unknown outcome: show 'Not yet confirmed', never success (RR-UNB-UX-003-r1)
version_compatibility: Semantic version in the embed URL path (/widgets/<type>/v<major>/); a major version is supported for at least the deprecation window published in the widget contract (period set by platform policy; not assumed here) with deprecation events sent to the host; minor versions are backward compatible; the event schema is versioned with the widget; hosts pin major versions; breaking changes require a new major and partner notice.
